news.title: Graduates and employers differ on career preparedness
news.summary_en: New data from Cengage’s 2026 Graduate Employability Report finds the connection between education and employment is changing as rising employer expectations redefine what it means to be career-ready.

news.title: How higher ed can fight fraud without collecting more student data
news.summary_en: As students settle into the academic year, colleges and universities are managing a growing identity challenge that extends far beyond enrollment.
